song.author: Elevation Worship
song.lyrics:
[V1] .Db Ab/C Gb I could sing Your name for all my life .Db Ab/C Gb Bbm And still find more to love each time
[P1] (PRECHORUS) . Ab Gb Jesus be the Name ever on our lips . Bbm Ab Gb It's sweeter every time that I call on it
[C1] (CHORUS 1) . Ebm There's just something 'bout Your Name . Gb There's just something 'bout Your Name . Db There's just something 'bout Your Name . Ab That makes me cry holy . Ebm Gb There is no other name, there is no other name . Db Ab There is no other name, Jesus You're worthy
[V2] .Db Ab Gb You have been the friend who never left .Db Ab Gb Bbm I won't forget Your faithfulness *** PRECHORUS, CHORUS 1 x2 ***
[B1] (BRIDGE) . Ebm Jesus Your Name is like the morning light . Gb The one the darkness can't deny . Bbm Ab The resurrection and the life, Jesus . Ebm Jesus Your Name can save, Your Name can heal . Gb Your Name can make the storm be still . Bbm Ab You never fail, You never will, Jesus
[B2] . Ebm Jesus the bread of life broken for us . Gb The wounded and the worthy one . Bbm Ab The first the last and soon to come, Jesus . Ebm Jesus the King who overwhelmed the grave . Gb The Lord who will forever reign . Bbm Ab The Name above all other names, Jesus
[C2] (CHORUS 2 x2) . Ebm Gb Jesus be the Name, Jesus be the Name . Db Bbm Ab Jesus be the Name that gets all the glory . Ebm Gb Jesus be the Name, Jesus be the Name . Db Bbm Ab Jesus be the Name that gets all the glory *** BRIDGE INSTRUMENTAL, CHORUS 2 ***
[C3] (OUTRO / ALT CHORUSES) . Ebm There's healing in Your Name . Gb There's healing in Your Name . Db There's healing in Your Name . Ab It makes me cry holy . Ebm There's freedom in Your Name . Gb There's freedom in Your Name . Db There's freedom in Your Name . Ab It makes me cry holy
[C4] . Ebm There's salvation in Your Name . Gb Salvation in Your Name alone . Db Salvation in Your Name . Ab It makes me cry holy . Ebm Gb Jesus be the Name, Jesus be the Name . Db Ab Gb Jesus be the Name that gets all the glory ... (end)
song.title: Jesus Be The Name
